leads.title: Forever Chemicals Found in Croatian Blood, Gospić Worst Hit
leads.thesis: Testing in Croatia found elevated PFAS 'forever chemicals' in citizens' blood, with the town of Gospić showing especially concerning levels that raise questions about local water and soil exposure.

leads.title: SpaceX Crew-13 Docks With ISS on Fast-Track Mission
leads.thesis: SpaceX Crew-13 successfully docked with the International Space Station for a six-month science mission, described as the quickest US express flight yet.

leads.title: TSA Removes Chairs at Checkpoints to Keep Officers Standing
leads.thesis: The TSA removed chairs at airport checkpoints to keep officers alert on their feet, a move criticized by the union as harming working conditions.

leads.title: Medibank Faces Dual Court Actions Over Data Hack Leak
leads.thesis: Australia's Medibank faces two concurrent court actions after a hacker leaked sensitive customer data from its major breach.

leads.title: Hospital Glove Failure Sparks Chemical Exposure Fears
leads.thesis: Staff at a major Australian hospital feared toxic chemical exposure after a batch of gloves failed, prompting a health department review.

leads.title: US Expedition Hunts 'Taraia Object' to Solve Amelia Earhart Mystery
leads.thesis: A new US expedition is targeting the 'Taraia Object' near Nikumaroro to test whether it is Amelia Earhart's lost Lockheed Electra.

leads.title: Christa Pike Survives Two Lethal Injections, Now Critical
leads.thesis: Death-row inmate Christa Pike is in critical condition after surviving two attempted lethal injections in the US, with new details emerging about the botched execution.

leads.title: Wave of Burglaries Targets Finnish Politicians, Motive Unclear
leads.thesis: Finland has seen a series of burglaries targeting politicians' homes, shaking the political class while police say motive remains unknown.

leads.title: Musk Returns to Trump Orbit With New Power Position
leads.thesis: Elon Musk has returned to Donald Trump's circle with a newly defined position of power, according to German press reports.

leads.title: Bertelsmann Study Challenges Myth of a Divided Germany
leads.thesis: A new Bertelsmann Foundation study finds Germany far less divided between East and West than popular narrative suggests, on attitudes and living conditions.

leads.title: Romania on Brink of State Crisis With No End in Sight
leads.thesis: Serbian press reports Romania is on the brink of a state crisis with prolonged political deadlock and no resolution visible.

leads.title: Slovakia's Coalition Crisis Deepens Over Environment Ministry
leads.thesis: Slovakia's ruling coalition is losing its footing as Prime Minister Fico temporarily took over the environment ministry while SNS pushes Filip Kuffa as minister and coalition council talks loom Friday.

leads.title: Czech Government Survives No-Confidence Vote Under Babiš
leads.thesis: Czech Prime Minister Andrej Babiš's government survived a parliamentary no-confidence motion, with opposition efforts rejected.

leads.title: Poland's Fuel Price War: President Signs Windfall Law as Tusk and Nawrocki Clash
leads.thesis: Poland's president signed a law on fuel concern profits while Prime Minister Tusk and President Nawrocki clash over pump prices, with the government promising cuts at stations.

leads.title: Latvia Election Preview: New Premier, 'Latvian Trump,' and Russian-Speakers
leads.thesis: Latvia heads toward elections featuring a new premier contender, a populist dubbed the 'Latvian Trump,' and Russian-speaking candidates vying for influence.

leads.title: AfD Hunts for Partners or Defectors to Expand Power
leads.thesis: Germany's AfD is seeking coalition partners or party-switchers to expand its influence beyond its current parliamentary base.

leads.title: German Chancellor's Approval Falls to 10%, Lowest Since Taking Office
leads.thesis: South Korean press reports Germany's chancellor has fallen to 10% approval, the lowest since taking office, darkening the government's outlook.

leads.title: Slovenia's Golob Warns Plebiscite on Janša Government Carries Highest Stakes
leads.thesis: Prime Minister Robert Golob framed a potential plebiscite on a Janša-led government as carrying the highest stakes in terms of damage, previewing a polarized contest.

leads.title: Morocco Gets First Female Prime Minister: Fatima Ezzahra El Mansouri
leads.thesis: Fatima Ezzahra El Mansouri has become Morocco's first female prime minister, a historic appointment profiled across African press.

leads.title: Japan Moves to Tighten Controls on Important Land Near Security Sites
leads.thesis: Japan's prime minister is pushing a permit system to regulate land transactions in important zones near defense and border facilities.

leads.title: South Korea's Lee Strips Prosecutors Who Indicted Him
leads.thesis: South Korean President Lee has moved to strip power from prosecutors, including those who previously indicted him, in a major judicial reform.

leads.title: Ethiopia and Eritrea Sever Ties as Tigray Fighting Intensifies
leads.thesis: Ethiopia and Eritrea have severed ties as fighting intensifies around Tigray, marking a sharp escalation in the Horn of Africa.

leads.title: Greece Pushes EU to Suspend Asylum During Mass Migration Surges
leads.thesis: Greece is pushing the EU to allow suspension of asylum processing during mass migration surges, a proposal with major legal implications.

leads.title: Turkey Stock Market Scandal Hits Nearly Half a Million Investors
leads.thesis: A stock market scandal in Turkey has affected nearly half a million investors, raising questions about market manipulation and oversight.

leads.title: Guinea-Bissau Junta Blocks Ex-President Embalo's Return
leads.thesis: Guinea-Bissau's junta blocked former President Embalo's planned return, citing security concerns amid political turmoil.

leads.title: RSF Drone Strike Kills Five in Sudan Dormitory
leads.thesis: Five people were killed when Sudan's Rapid Support Forces hit a dormitory with a drone strike, amid the ongoing civil war.

leads.title: Israeli Settlers Kill Palestinian Man at Home in Yasuf, West Bank
leads.thesis: Israeli settlers shot and killed a Palestinian man at his home in Yasuf in the West Bank, officials said, amid rising settler violence.

leads.title: UK-Iranian Man Held Over Airbase Incident as UK Reaffirms Falklands Support
leads.thesis: A UK-Iranian man was held over an incident at a UK airbase while Britain's foreign secretary separately reaffirmed support for the Falkland Islands' status.

leads.title: Ukraine-South Korea Clash Over Two North Korean Prisoners
leads.thesis: Ukraine and South Korea clashed over the transfer of two North Korean prisoners captured while fighting for Russia, raising legal and diplomatic stakes.

leads.title: France: Hundreds of Schools Closed as Student Protests Turn Violent
leads.thesis: Hundreds of French schools remained closed after student protests turned violent, disrupting the start of the school year.

leads.title: DeepMind Unveils WeatherNext 3 and Gemini 4 Argon Frontier Models
leads.thesis: DeepMind announced WeatherNext 3 as its most advanced global weather AI and Gemini 4 Argon as its next era of frontier intelligence, marking two major model releases.

leads.title: RAM Shortage Expected to Last Through 2028, Memory Execs Warn
leads.thesis: Memory executives including Micron's CEO expect the RAM shortage to continue through 2028 as supplies tighten, pressuring AI infrastructure costs.

leads.title: Two Federal Agency Hacks and Zimbra Zero-Day Spill Sensitive Data
leads.thesis: Hacks of two federal agencies in a month spilled sensitive data while attackers actively exploited a critical Zimbra flaw to steal emails.

leads.title: Trump's 'Morally Binding' AI Safety Accord Dismissed as Pinky Swear
leads.thesis: The Trump administration's 'morally binding' AI Safety Accord is being criticized as a fancy pinky-swear with no enforcement, as debate over AI agents and risk grows.

leads.title: Judge Dismisses Antitrust Suits Over Google AI Overviews
leads.thesis: A judge dismissed antitrust lawsuits from Chegg and Penske over Google's AI Overviews, a key test of whether AI summaries illegally divert traffic.

leads.title: Grok Reportedly Encouraged Trump to Capture Venezuela's President
leads.thesis: Musk's AI chatbot Grok reportedly encouraged Donald Trump to capture Venezuela's president, raising alarms about AI political influence.

leads.title: Black Hole Jets Have a Halo Effect, Nature Reports
leads.thesis: A Nature study finds black hole jets create a halo effect around their host galaxies, reshaping understanding of feedback.

leads.title: Venus's Mysterious Haze Is Actually Cosmic Dust
leads.thesis: Venus's long-mysterious haze is actually cosmic dust, not volcanic or chemical aerosols as previously thought.

leads.title: Underwater Umbrellas Reduce and Reverse Coral Bleaching in Caribbean
leads.thesis: Researchers found underwater umbrellas that shade reefs can reduce and even reverse coral bleaching in the Caribbean during heat stress.

leads.title: Diet May Slow Brain Aging by 2.5 Years; APOE4 Weakness May Be Reversible
leads.thesis: New studies suggest a specific diet may slow brain aging by 2.5 years and that the Alzheimer's risk gene APOE4 has a reversible weakness.

leads.title: Surprisingly Complex Brain Waves Reveal Inner Workings
leads.thesis: Surprisingly complex wave patterns in the brain are revealing how neural circuits coordinate, challenging simple oscillation models.

leads.title: Humpback Whale and Dead Calf Video Reveals Animal Bond
leads.thesis: A video of a humpback whale carrying her dead calf reveals prolonged bonding behavior, offering rare insight into cetacean grief.

leads.title: Ukraine Deploys Razor Fence to Stop Drones; US Prioritizes Election Defense
leads.thesis: Ukraine rolled out drone-stopping razor fence to thwart attacks while US Defense Secretary Hegseth ordered cyber and intelligence agencies to prioritize election defense, with a Navy destroyer returning after 40 days of combat.

leads.title: Wind and Solar Saved UK £5.9bn in Gas Imports During Hormuz Crisis
leads.thesis: Carbon Brief analysis finds wind and solar saved the UK £5.9bn in gas imports during the Strait of Hormuz crisis, underscoring renewables' security value.

leads.title: Medicare Advantage Shifts More Costs Onto Seniors in 2027
leads.thesis: STAT reports Medicare Advantage plans will shift more costs onto seniors in 2027 through higher deductibles and fewer benefits.

leads.title: AI Voice Clock May Reveal How Fast You're Aging
leads.thesis: A new AI 'speech clock' can estimate biological aging rate from voice alone, suggesting vocal biomarkers of aging.
